title: fix: apply current GPT-5.6 Sol pricing
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Corrected openai/gpt-5.6-sol Pollen pricing per million input, cached-input, cache-write, and output tokens to use Azure cost divided by three instead of registry cost divided by three. Updated the long-context pricing for requests above 272K prompt tokens, with the higher rates applying to the full request, plus the effective-price snapshot and cost-variant test. Quest + Paid access and model capabilities are unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli checks a glowing lime green (#ecf874) pricing ledger beside a small code-plant and a CRT monitor; she wears tiny accountant glasses and looks pleased that the numbers line up. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized in the scene, strictly pixel art, with a warm cream and soft pastel gradient background: cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
